title: 2026-2027 Etta Gray Memorial Scholarship Program (UNCF)
program_type: Need-based scholarship from a non-governmental organisation
duration: One-time award for the certification or degree programme in progress
description: The Etta Gray Memorial Scholarship Program, administered by the United Negro College Fund, provides a one-time USD 5,000 need-based scholarship award to students who have a permanent residence in upstate South Carolina and who are pursuing a technical certification at a two-year or four-year college or university in Upstate South Carolina. It was established in honour of the memory of Etta Gray, a loving caregiver for the William Hipp family. title: Frederick Douglass Bicentennial Scholarship Program (UNCF)
program_type: Need-based scholarship for HBCU students, administered by a non-governmental organisation
duration: Award to an HBCU senior; no renewal terms are described on the official page
description: The Frederick Douglass Bicentennial Scholarship Program was established by Tony Signore and funded by the Signore Family to support students attending accredited historically black colleges and universities nationwide. UNCF administers and manages the programme for 20 years, through academic year 2038-39. Each year the programme awards two USD 10,000 scholarships to exceptional HBCU seniors who have demonstrated high academic achievement, strong leadership skills, a commitment to community service and unmet financial need. title: Becas El Quantificador 2026-2027 (LIDE + DataCamp)
official_source: Laboratorio de Investigacion para el Desarrollo del Ecuador (LIDE)
program_type: NGO and corporate sponsored data-skills bursary with free platform access
duration: 12 months of DataCamp licence access, from 1 November 2026 to 1 November 2027
description: The Becas El Quantificador promote data literacy among university students of scarce economic means through free DataCamp licences and data-analysis and employability workshops. Launched by LIDE in 2022 in alliance with DataCamp under the DataCamp Donates programme, the scholarship consists of a one-year DataCamp licence to study data analysis and data science. The programme is located throughout Ecuador and funded by DataCamp, with an annual programme budget of US$6,000.
